topic.title: Junos System & Chassis Alarm Troubleshooting

check.item: Affected FRU or hardware component (FPC, PIC, SFP, RE, PSU, Fan Tray)
Environmental conditions (Inlet/Outlet temperature thresholds in Celsius)
Power conditions (PSU input/output voltage, feed failure, redundancy state)

alarm.name: PEM Failure / Power Supply Offline
alarm.matchingPattern: Power Supply Failure | PEM Failure | Power Feed Lost
alarm.description: Indicates a failed power supply unit (PSU/PEM), loss of input feed, or unpopulated power slot without redundancy.

alarm.name: Over Temperature / Fan Failure
alarm.matchingPattern: Over Temperature | Temperature Shutdown | Fan Failure | Fan Speed Low
alarm.description: Chassis temperature exceeded warning or critical thresholds, or a fan tray failure impaired chassis airflow.

alarm.name: Routing Engine / Mastership Issue
alarm.matchingPattern: RE Offline | Mastership Lost | Hard Disk Error
alarm.description: Loss of communication with a secondary Routing Engine, disk failure, or split-brain mastership issue.

alarm.name: Loss of Signal (LOS)
alarm.matchingPattern: Loss of Signal | RX Loss | Link Down
alarm.description: SFP/XFP optic is receiving zero or degraded optical light power (Rx < sensitivity threshold) from the fiber span.

alarm.name: SFP Transceiver Unrecognized / Invalid
alarm.matchingPattern: Unrecognized Optics | SFP Not Supported | SFP I2C Read Error
alarm.description: Inserted optical module failed I2C read, is non-vendor compliant, or unsupported on the specific FPC/PIC.

alarm.name: Loss of Frame (LOF) / Alarm Indication Signal (AIS)
alarm.matchingPattern: Loss of Frame | Remote Defect Indication | AIS Received
alarm.description: Framing layer mismatch or transport provider circuit defect downstream on the OTN/SONET/Ethernet span.

alarm.name: Rescue Configuration Missing
alarm.description: System software missing a saved baseline rescue configuration state on storage media.

alarm.name: License Expired / Grace Period Active
alarm.description: Licensed JunOS feature (e.g., L2VPN, Subscriber Management) operating without a valid permanent license key.

alarm.name: Protocol / BGP Peer Down Alarm
alarm.matchingPattern: BGP Peer Down | Autodrop Active | Interface Down
alarm.description: Monitored critical routing peer or tracking interface went offline, triggering a system-level alarm notification.

topic.workflow: Correlate system and chassis alarms with interface events, optical light levels (show interfaces diagnostics optics), and routing protocol changes. Never clear alarms (clear system alarms / clear chassis alarms) before capturing diagnostic telemetry evidence.
